subject: Zoning Ordinance Update RFP
overview: The committee met with Planning Director Alicia Hunt to review consultant proposals for updating the city's zoning ordinance to reflect the adopted comprehensive plan. The council approved a motion designating a three-member committee to complete scoring and negotiate a contract with their preferred vendor.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Update RFP (Paper 22-533)
items.summary: Councilors reviewed proposals from Innes Associates and Fisher Associates, expressing consensus support for Innes Associates based on their prior work on Medford's comprehensive plan and zoning recodification. The committee approved a motion authorizing Council President Morell, Vice President Bears, and Director Hunt to serve as the selection committee, complete required evaluations, and negotiate a contract based on price proposals.
